title: Movement information in neural latent representations
scientific_question: How well does a representation fitted without assessment velocity preserve movement information on eight held-out maze groups under a matched ten-dimensional readout comparison?
primary_outputs: Measured, filtered two-axis hand velocity in physical m/s for 126 assessment trials×140 bins.

data_manifest.prepared_split_warning: Train/test NWBs and MC_Maze Large/Medium/Small variants are derived releases of a source acquisition, not independent datasets.

recording_contract.neural: Actual NWB header confirms units/spike_times with ragged spike_times_index, heldout-unit flags and observation intervals;182units in the inspected training file. Unit labels are not persistent identities across other sessions.
recording_contract.labels: Actual training NWB contains2295trial-table rows and columns active_target, barrier_pos, barrier_pos_index, delay, go_cue_time, id, maze_id, move_onset_time, num_barriers, num_targets, rt, split, start_time, stop_time, success, target_on_time, target_pos, target_pos_index, trial_type, trial_version. Hand position/velocity are timestamped behavioral arrays. Additional labels must be masked when they are prediction targets.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Sorted spike timestamps and trial/event times are aligned in the NWB time base. Official NWBDataset bins spikes on a1ms grid and resamples for5ms/20ms benchmarks; MC_Maze behavior uses timestamps, Area2 uses starting_time/rate. Rate values and unit conversion still need acquisition qualification.

biological_ids.session_description: Data from monkey Jenkins performing center-out delayed reaching task. This file contains trials from the full session on 2009-09-25 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.

recording_contract.evidence: Direct published asset URL inspected with bounded HTTP ranges; HDF5 names/shapes and identity metadata only, not neural/behavior values.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: 1340 official-training trials from 28 maze groups: uint16[1340,140,137]counts per 5 ms and training float64 velocity[m/s].
126 official-validation assessment trials from 8 disjoint maze groups with 137 observed-unit counts.
Anonymous training group/fourfold IDs; neural clock[-250,450)ms and velocity clock[-150,550)ms; axesx,y.
forbidden_inputs: Assessment velocity, held maze labels/source-trial identity, raw NWB or prior 017/018 packets.
Assessment labels in PCA, scaling, ridge tuning or phase-template fitting.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: All 126 anonymous assessment_trial_ids, exact x/y order,140 velocity edges and panel_fingerprint. Identity-preserving reordering is accepted; literal source IDs are not distributed.
allowed_inputs.split: 1340 training trials/28 maze groups versus 126 assessment trials/8 different maze groups; all maze versions stay together. Four whole-maze training folds fit preprocessing and tune the readout without assessment targets.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Full 126×140×2 velocity trajectory; all 8 maze groups included equally. This is a declared subset of the 2295 trial source with different role eligibility, not the full 017/018 panel or another cohort.

primary.name: equal_maze_group_macro_uniform_axis_R2
primary.aggregation: Within each held maze group pool trial/time samples, compute x/y R2 against group-specific means, average the axes equally, then average all 8 groups equally.
primary.rationale: Prevents trial-rich maze groups or high-variance axes from defining the entire transfer result; negative R2 remains meaningful.

secondary: Matched PCA10-minus-random 10 contrast requires verified identical fitting and readout access.

comparators.name: pca10_vs_random10
comparators.inputs: Identical 137 unit training counts and training velocity;10-dimensional representation each.
comparators.procedure: Implemented symmetric 50 ms Gaussian smoothing, training-fold scaling, PCA or fixed seeded QRrandom projection, identical ridge grid[0.01,0.1,1,10] and four whole-group folds.

comparators.name: phase_only_and_raw137
comparators.inputs: Training movement phase alone or full 137 unit count representation.
comparators.procedure: Fixed training-only phase template and 137 dimensional residual ridge are controls; raw 137 has greater feature capacity and is not the matched latent contrast.

nuisance_controls: Recompute every fitted transform inside training folds; no velocity in unsupervised representation fitting.
Keep all variants of each maze in one role/fold.
Report movement-phase-only performance and disclose symmetric neural/target filtering.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired maze/trial-block uncertainty is descriptive within one animal; keep maze dependence and no bin/neuron pseudoreplication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all 126×140×2 finite signed predictions in m/s and exact identities/clock. No clipping/fill. Any constant target axis in a held group makes the primary undefined with that group retained.
